title: 5X 50ml Fantasi Remix Bundle | 70/30 E-Liquid Bundle
description:
50ml Fantasi Remix 70/30 E-Liquids:
Thirsting for some twisted fruity flavours? This E-liquid package has got everything you need – and more!
Brimming with our most popular Fantasi Remix varieties, this crazy bundle has got something for every corner of your palette.
If you’re after maximum flavor for maximum value, look no further.
This kit includes 5x 50ml bottles of delicious 70/30 e-liquid, available in either 0mg or 3mg nicotine.
Choose between nicotine salts and freebase nicotine to create your perfect vaping experience.
Blackcurrant X Lemonade:  Juicy, sweet blackberries blended with tart, citrusy lemon for a well-rounded, sugary hit that will leave your taste buds tingling.
Blue Raspberry X Cherry: Sugary-sweet, this delectable combo fuses the mouth-watering flavors of blue raspberries and glossed cherries, producing an untamed blast of candy flavor .
Blue Raspberry X Lemonade: Blue razz gets a little added fizz with this world-winning combo. Experience a barrage of sweet candy flavour, balanced with a lemony citrus edge.
Grape X Strawberry: A rich fusion of freshly picked grapes and ripe, plump strawberries, this wild combination delivers a tantalizing sweet, sour, juicy medley of your favorite summer fruits.
Tropical  x Thunder:Experience an award-winning explosion of tropical flavours with this wild medley of sunny fruits. With notes of sweet mango, sour kiwi, tart pineapple, and ripe papaya, this is the ultimate island adventure.
This great-value Fantasi Remix bundle comes packed with 5x 50ml bottles of our mouth-watering juice combinations! Mixed to a 70/30 VG PG ratio, this e-liquid is perfectly suited to sub-ohm and pod vapes.
Available in nicotine-free 0mg and 3mg nicotine. Pick between nic salts or freebase nicotine to create your desired vaping experience. Nic salts provide a smooth throat hit and an immediate nicotine release, while freebase provides a stronger throat hit and a more gradual release.
Ingredients
VG – Vegetable Glycerine (70%)
PG – Propylene Glycol (30%)
Vapoholic Flavouring
What’s in the Bundle?
1x Blackcurrant x Lemon
1x Blue Raspberry x Cherry
1x Blue Raspberry x Lemonade
1x Grape x Strawberry
1x Tropical x Thunder
Specifications:
Ratio
70/30
Size
50ml, 60ml
Nicotine Strength
3mg
Flavor
Ice Cool
Highlights:
Shake things up with your favorite Fantasi Remix flavors!
70/30 ratio for sub-ohm devices
Perfect for thick clouds!
Choose from nicotine-free, nic salts, or freebase nicotine
